Nothing charged. confirming: paid or held, the booking is with the hotel. confirmed: the hotel confirmed and the payment is charged. failed: no stay was booked; payment.status says what became of the money. cancelling, then cancelled: a cancellation under the terms. needs_attention: a person at Fortrip has to resolve it.

unspecifiedMainMeals.description: Main meals a day beyond included that the rate doesn't name (e.g. 1 when a half-board rate doesn't say lunch or dinner); null when known is false.

guestsCoveredPerRoom.description: How many guests in each room the meals are for; fewer than the guests in the room means not everyone gets them. null when not stated.

meals.description: What the rate includes to eat. known false: the meals are unknown, not none, and included, unspecifiedMainMeals and allInclusive are null.

asOf.description: When these terms were read: status and penalties are as of this time.

cancellation.description: The terms the order was made on, read at asOf; cancel says whether it can be cancelled now.

payAtProperty.description: Fees paid at the property, on top of price.total, in the property's currency, not converted. disclosure incomplete: there may be fees not listed.

total.description: The whole stay for all rooms, in payment.chargeCurrency: what paying charges, or once paid what was charged. Fees payable at the property are not in it.

url.description: The payment page, on fortrip.ai. With requiresSignIn false it continues to Stripe Checkout, and anyone holding it can pay; with requiresSignIn true (an order started on the Fortrip website) it continues to the Fortrip booking page, where only the signed-in owner can pay. null when the order isn't awaiting payment, or, while it is, when the link couldn't be read this time: read the order again.

expiresAt.description: When the time to pay ends: an order unpaid by then expires, with nothing charged. null unless status is awaiting_payment.

chargeCurrency.description: The currency the order is charged in: USD for an order made through the API; an order made on the Fortrip website may be in another.

localCurrencyAtCheckout.description: Whether paying by url may charge the card in its own currency, converted by Stripe; false once paid by token, Alipay or WeChat Pay.

localCharge.description: What the card was charged in its own currency, when Stripe converted the total; otherwise null.

handler.description: The com.stripe.payments handler, which takes the token.

maxAmount.description: Request the token for at least this amount, in cents; a token that allows less can't pay.

currency.description: The token's currency, lowercase as Stripe takes it: usd.

expiresAt.description: Request the token valid until at least this time; the order can't be paid after it.

limits.description: What the shared payment token for pay_order must allow.

anyOf.description: A Stripe shared payment token, through pay_order's sharedPaymentToken or payment. The entry is absent when a token can't pay the order: over $500, not charged in USD, an order started on the Fortrip website, a negotiated price, under 15 minutes left, 5 tokens tried, a token payment is under way, an Alipay or WeChat Pay payment is open, or token payment isn't offered for this order.

open.description: Whether pay_order has opened an Alipay or WeChat Pay payment on this order.

current.description: Which of the two the payment is on now; null until it is open.

qrData.description: The WeChat Pay code's content, to draw as a QR code; null when there is no live code (open wechatPay.url for one).

qrImageUrl.description: A 480 px PNG of the same code.

url.description: A link, on fortrip.ai, for the user to pay with WeChat Pay; anyone holding it can pay.

wechatPay.description: The WeChat Pay code and link; null until the payment is open.

url.description: A link, on fortrip.ai, for the user to pay with Alipay; anyone holding it can pay.

alipay.description: The Alipay link; null until the payment is open.

anyOf.description: Paying with Alipay or WeChat Pay: pass method stripe_alipay_wechat_pay to pay_order to open it. The entry is absent when the order can't be paid this way and none is open.

methods.description: What pay_order accepts for this order now, by id. [] means: give the user payment.url, when it isn't null.

available.description: Whether the user can cancel the order now, or, unpaid (reason unpaid), close it.

reason.description: cancellable: a paid order can be cancelled now; unpaid: an unpaid order can be closed; otherwise why not.

penalty.description: The penalty if cancelled now, under the accepted terms, in the charge currency; null when not stated.

refund.description: What a cancellation now refunds: what was paid less the penalty, in the charge currency; null when not stated.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

matched.description: Hotels that match the destination, the text and every filter but the price filter.

priced.description: Hotels priced: those on this page, or with a price sort or price filter the whole priced set (pricing.scope); null without prices.

withPrice.description: Of those priced, how many have an indicative price; null when prices weren't asked for or are unavailable.

poolRadiusMeters.description: When a price sort or price filter priced only the nearest 3,000: how far the farthest of them is from the center, in meters; otherwise null.

excludedNoPrice.description: With a price filter: priced hotels left out for having no indicative price; otherwise null.

excludedNoFacilityData.description: With an amenity filter: hotels left out for listing no facilities at all, though they may have the amenity; otherwise null.

withinMaxRadius.description: For a radius under 80,000 m: how many would match within 80,000 m of the center; otherwise null.

textAnywhere.description: With text and a place: the hotels that match the text anywhere in the place's country; otherwise null.

localities.description: For an area: its top localities, the towns its matching hotels belong to; otherwise null.

nameAsText.description: When a place_name search matched few hotels: how many in its country match the name as text; otherwise null.

coverage.description: What the search covered: counts of hotels, each null when it doesn't apply.

photo.description: The cover photo; null when there is none.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.
